user.title: Connect to Seedboxes.cc
user.description: Enter your Seedboxes.cc account credentials. If browser verification blocks automatic login, the integration will offer session cookie authentication.

select_seedbox.title: Choose a seedbox
select_seedbox.description: Several seedboxes were found on this account. Select the one to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Seedboxes.cc
reauth_confirm.description: Authentication for seedbox {seedbox_id} failed. Enter the current Seedboxes.cc account credentials.

session_cookie.title: Browser verification required
session_cookie.description: Seedboxes.cc now protects automatic login with Turnstile. Sign in through a browser, then copy the session_id cookie value and the seedbox ID.

reauth_session_cookie.title: Reconnect Seedboxes.cc with a cookie
reauth_session_cookie.description: Automatic login for seedbox {seedbox_id} is blocked by browser verification. Enter a new session_id cookie.

error.invalid_auth: The account credentials are invalid or this account cannot access the requested seedbox.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Seedboxes.cc, discover a seedbox, or complete its login flow.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.
error.invalid_session: The session cookie is invalid, expired, or cannot access this seedbox.

abort.discovery_failed: The seedbox discovery session expired. Start the setup again.
abort.reauth_failed: Unable to find the integration entry to reauthenticate.
